name: Jellyfin Graveyard Analytics
description: Manage your server's afterlife. Identify lifeless media, condemn dead weight to The Chapel, and track your active Visitors.
overview: Advanced storage reclamation and user analytics.

versions.changelog: Fixes the Guestbook failing on Jellyfin 10.11.9 and newer, where an API change made it error out. Also: stored XSS and webhook authentication fixes; Plays, Time Played and Reach now reconcile; a rebuilt dashboard with loading, empty and error states; cached aggregates instead of a library walk per row; and a test suite. Minimum server is 10.11.6.
The Chapel Update: Automated collection branding, thematic iconography, and .NET 9 performance optimizations.
Initial Release: Opening the gates to Graveyard Analytics v1.0.
